# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Monk level 7 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E3/E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Monk
# level-1/level-2/level-3/level-4/level-5/level-6 martial chassis baseline to
# level 7 as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain
# derived, computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human
# race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat) and the deterministic
# ability/feat/skill/equipment posture from the level-1 through level-6
# fixtures, adding only the level bump this bounded tranche needs. The
# level-1 monk_bonus_feat choice (Stunning Fist) is carried forward
# unchanged — PF1 also grants monks SEPARATE bonus feats at 2nd and 6th
# level, but this slice deliberately does not add a new choice-slot for
# either (mirroring the Rogue level-7 precedent: no fixture data and no
# recognition code exist for a repeat bonus-feat grant; it stays named but
# unproven, unchanged by this widening).
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Monk burden surface: no execution of
# what the recognized bonus feat actually does, no level-2/level-6 bonus
# feat grant recognition, no ki-power execution (extra attack, AC bonus, or
# speed bonus), no fall-damage engine, no High Jump, no Wholeness of Body
# execution, and no level-8+ progression. The unarmed strike damage die
# (confirmed to stay 1d8 at level 7, unchanged from levels 4-6, verified
# independently against d20pfsrd and legacy.aonprd.com's Medium-monk damage
# progression table — the 1d8 band runs levels 4-7), the Flurry of Blows
# flat attack bonus (steps to +5/+5 at level 7 via the same `monk level - 2`
# formula, attack count staying 2 — the third flurry attack is not gained
# until 8th level, verified independently against both primary sources'
# verbatim Flurry of Blows rule text), and Still Mind's unchanged flat +2
# magnitude are the pillars this fixture exercises. The PF1 Core Rulebook
# Monk class table's level-7 "Special" column names "Wholeness of Body" (and,
# per both primary sources, a ki pool material upgrade against damage
# reduction) — checked and confirmed NOT flat (Wholeness of Body requires
# spending 2 ki points as a standard action to heal an amount of damage
# equal to monk level, and the ki-pool material upgrade requires a
# damage-reduction-bypass-resolution engine; neither a ki-point-consumption/
# healing-resolution engine nor a damage-reduction-bypass-resolution engine
# exists in this codebase), so both are deliberately left named but unproven,
# not fabricated.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-monk-level7
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:monk:7
ability=strength:13
ability=dexterity:16
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:8
ability=wisdom:17
ability=charisma:10
feat=feat:stunning_fist
skill=skill:acrobatics:1
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:monk_bonus_feat:feat:stunning_fist
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:wisdom
